description: This file defines a Java interface for mapping scenarios from a Ditto Adaptable to external messages, within a benchmarking package for JavaScript-related mapping in the Ditto connectivity services.

classes.name: MapFromDittoProtocolScenario
classes.description: Interface for scenarios mapping from a Ditto Adaptable object to an external message.

methods.name: getMessageMapper
methods.description: Returns the MessageMapper instance used in the scenario.

methods.name: getDittoAdaptable
methods.description: Retrieves the Adaptable object from Ditto that is used in the scenario.
